401 Unauthorized error on embedding request when API key is invalid

```elixir title="Elixir"
try do
  api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
  {:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_embed_async(client, "{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
end
```
